nodes.label: Launch Video Contact Sheet (5 frames)

nodes.label: Team Climbing Growth Chart Illustration
nodes.rationale: Flat green-themed marketing illustration: four business people help each other climb a rising arrow over an ascending bar chart. Likely a hero/landing visual conveying financial growth and forecasting for the app.

nodes.label: Vite Logo (default favicon SVG)
nodes.rationale: Stock Vite scaffold asset (blue-purple gradient chevron with yellow lightning bolt); a leftover from the Vite project template, not custom branding.

nodes.label: NSE Holiday Calendar (2025)
nodes.rationale: MARKET_HOLIDAYS_2025 is the only list, so forecast dates after 2025 skip weekends but not exchange holidays.

nodes.label: Technical Indicators (EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, OBV)
nodes.norm_label: technical indicators (ema, rsi, macd, bollinger bands, obv)
nodes.rationale: Computed from three months of daily prices because MACD needs 26 sessions.

nodes.label: Trade Call Rule (Buy/Sell/Hold/Avoid/No Action)
nodes.rationale: Combines sentiment thresholds (+/-0.05) with RSI bounds (70/30) and whether the user already holds the stock.

nodes.label: Rate Limits
nodes.rationale: Routes that train a model or spend a NewsData credit share a per-IP budget (10/minute); auth allows 10 failed logins per 15 min and 5 sign-ups per hour. Limits are in-memory per process, so proxies must forward client addresses.

nodes.label: FinBERT Sentiment
nodes.rationale: Loaded once at startup; headlines scored in one batch into a mean signed score between -1 and 1; a FinBERT failure is currently reported as neutral (CHARACTERISES ERR-01).

nodes.label: svm.py SVC Research Script
nodes.rationale: SVC direction classifier with GridSearchCV tuning kept standalone; wiring it into the API is on the roadmap.

nodes.label: SVR Forecaster
nodes.rationale: RBF SVR with fixed C=1e3, gamma=0.1, trained on at most the latest 2,520 rows so one request cannot monopolise the CPU; hold-out metrics only reach the server log.

nodes.label: Batch the Slow Parts
nodes.rationale: FinBERT scores all headlines in one call, /stock-prices uses one yfinance download cached 60 s behind a lock, and /predict reuses the downloaded frame for the current quote.

nodes.label: Sentiment Forecast Adjustment (1 + 0.1 x s)
nodes.rationale: News sentiment nudges the SVR forecast by at most +/-10%.

nodes.label: Train on Demand
nodes.rationale: No stored model: each forecast fits a fresh scaler and SVR so results follow the latest data, at the cost of latency on every request.

nodes.label: bcrypt with Forced-Reset Path
nodes.rationale: Passwords are bcrypt hashes (10 rounds); legacy accounts get 403 PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED. No self-service reset because without email verification it would be an account-takeover route.

nodes.label: Offline Tests
nodes.rationale: conftest.py replaces transformers.pipeline before import, Yahoo Finance and NewsData.io are faked, and auth tests mock MySQL, so suites need no network, model download or database.

nodes.label: No Real Sessions
nodes.rationale: Login returns the user record kept in localStorage; no token is issued, the prediction API is unauthenticated and pages have no route guards.

nodes.label: Real Status Codes
nodes.rationale: 404/422/429/502 each carry a detail message the dashboard shows as-is; the 502 message is fixed so exception details stay in the server log.
